152138.creator: Richard Nicolaüs Roland Holst

editorial.note: Unlike the early 19th-century works in the adjacent display cases, this painting does not show a landscape but rather an impression of nature. In the late 19th century, some painters sought more personal ways of depicting nature.

152183.title: Lane of Oaks in Late Summer
152183.creator: Maria Bilders-van Bosse

editorial.note: Marie Bilders-van Bosse likely painted this picture in the vicinity of Oosterbeek, where she moved after her marriage. She was a member of the Hague School, a group of painters who focussed on capturing the atmosphere and light of nature.
It seems as if Van Looy has lavishly strewn blue flowers all over this large canvas.
